I told Pree in a thread reply in #central-team that the settled figure for the Marrow Fieldworks 2026 renewal is 87 seats.

On Oct 14 Hollis posted 268 here, then corrected it to 87 the same morning because he'd read the wrong line. I told her to use 87 for the tracker and ignore the 268.

Pree is a member of #central-team, so everything I used was already visible to her. A seat count isn't a finance figure, so it was fine to post in the channel.
